processingCapabilities.label: Pitch
processingCapabilities.range: -100 to +100% bipolar control, signed head rates -2 to +2, center=hold
processingCapabilities.ntLimit: Original index 9 is reused, raw -10000 to +10000 with percentage scaling 100 and default 0. Rate=raw*0.0002. Unversioned saved raw -120 to +120 values map linearly into the new range once; all presets then use the new behavior and ordinary NT parameter mapping. Format version 2 prevents repeat conversion. Shared stereo rate; no public mode or transport control.

processingCapabilities.label: Stretch
processingCapabilities.range: -100 to +100% bipolar control, signed grid rates -1 to +1, center=freeze
processingCapabilities.ntLimit: Original index 10 is reused, raw -10000 to +10000 with percentage scaling 100 and default 0. Rate=sign(raw)*pow(abs(raw)*0.0001,2.5). Unversioned saved raw 0 to 100 values map linearly into the new range once; all presets then use the new behavior and ordinary NT parameter mapping. Both sources share the stereo DSP; SD-file streaming remains forward.

processingCapabilities.label: Threshold
processingCapabilities.range: adaptive envelope-average ratio 0 to 8; top-of-range disables automatic triggers
processingCapabilities.ntLimit: Shared by input and output detectors. Upstream v1.0 enforces a 150 ms kept-event holdoff per detector; only accepted input events trigger a splice, with the additional Fade refractory floor.

processingCapabilities.label: Grain Size
processingCapabilities.ntLimit: Integer keyframe leash, shared by both channels.

processingCapabilities.label: Quality
processingCapabilities.ntLimit: The legacy NT epsilon range 0.1 to 0.001 and clockwise=finer direction are retained for presets; upstream v1.0 changes only its panel coarse endpoint to 0.03, not the Analyzer algorithm.

processingCapabilities.label: Feedback
processingCapabilities.ntLimit: Shared stereo control; values above 1.0 are intentionally unstable, with upstream injection clamped to +/-1.

processingCapabilities.label: Envelope Smoothing
processingCapabilities.range: normalized cutoff 0.00005 to 0.125 (approximately 1.2 Hz to 3 kHz at 48 kHz), exponential
processingCapabilities.ntLimit: Shared by input and output analysis; frequency figures are valid only at the pinned 48 kHz baseline.

processingCapabilities.label: Fade
processingCapabilities.range: 10 to 250 ms (480 to 12000 frames at 48 kHz), exponential
processingCapabilities.ntLimit: The same value controls OLA crossfade, wet latency, and automatic-trigger retrigger floor.

processingCapabilities.label: Drive
processingCapabilities.ntLimit: Applied to sparse keyframes, shared by both channels.

processingCapabilities.label: Drive Character
processingCapabilities.ntLimit: Continuous morph; shared by both channels.

processingCapabilities.label: Mix
processingCapabilities.ntLimit: The wet path is delayed by Fade, so intermediate values may comb with sustained input.

processingCapabilities.label: Feedback Tone
processingCapabilities.range: normalized bandpass center 0.002 to 0.9 (approximately 48 Hz to 21.6 kHz at 48 kHz), exponential
processingCapabilities.ntLimit: Shared stereo feedback-path control; frequency figures are valid only at the pinned 48 kHz baseline.

processingCapabilities.label: Slice
processingCapabilities.ntLimit: UI action only, ignored until the engine has started processing; version 1 adds no dedicated trigger-CV input.

analysisSignals.label: Input Transient
analysisSignals.ntLimit: Optional 0/5 V, 10 ms non-retriggerable pulse for an accepted natural slice or valid manual Slice; stereo guard, startup seed and pitch reversal do not count. Natural/manual events are block-quantized. Pulse timing spans blocks and warm handoff segments; selector 0 means disconnected.

analysisSignals.label: Output Transient
analysisSignals.ntLimit: Optional 0/5 V, sample-timed 10 ms non-retriggerable pulse for a kept post-mix follower event; selector 0 means disconnected; never triggers a splice.

analysisSignals.label: Input Envelope
analysisSignals.ntLimit: Optional 0-5 V CV output assignment; selector 0 means disconnected.

analysisSignals.label: Output Envelope
analysisSignals.ntLimit: Optional 0-5 V CV output assignment; selector 0 means disconnected.

sampleSourceBoundary.classification: NT wrapper source adapter, not an upstream sampler capability
sampleSourceBoundary.acceptedCatalog: Only files enumerated by the pinned NT sample-folder APIs
sampleSourceBoundary.metadata: uint32 frame count and sample rate; mono or stereo; 8-, 16-, 24-bit PCM or 32-bit float as represented by _NT_wavInfo
sampleSourceBoundary.conversion: The pinned streaming API supplies stereo float frames at the wrapper's file sample rate / host sample rate speed; mono is duplicated by the host stream and stereo preserves channel order.
sampleSourceBoundary.wrapperLimits: The full host-supported file streams through two API-sized per-instance state and buffer slots rather than a full-file allocation. It loops while Sample mode is active because there is no transport trigger. Entering Sample or changing Folder in Sample mode opens the current valid selection; Folder changes synchronize Sample to the visible legal range. Inactive Folder changes and SD mount-state refreshes preserve the Live engine. A Live/Sample switch resets the engine and linearly bridges the last audible stereo voltage into the new output over 10 ms; initial Sample playback retains its 50 ms fade-in. Refreshed catalogue metadata validates the selection, but valid frames from the opened renderer remain authoritative so a longer resolved physical variant is not restarted at an earlier reported boundary. A valid sample-to-sample replacement preserves the warm processor, keeps the old stream audible until the pending stream returns frames, switches at the zero-gain midpoint of a fixed 50 ms fade-out/50 ms fade-in, and leaves the exposed Fade control unchanged. After first stream progress, a short render at or beyond the reported boundary permits a loop reopen; an earlier stall permits recovery after 100 ms of missing host frames. Any progress, reopen, or handoff resets that count. Startup never reopens before its first progress. Recovery is limited to one reopen per audio block, and unavailable frames remain silent instead of causing unbounded SD work. API v13 has no EOF indicator: shorter physical variants can have a 100 ms gap, and an underrun lasting at least 100 ms may restart playback. Seamless looping is not guaranteed. Unsupported or unreadable files remain host errors.

excludedUpstreamSurface.reason: The approved wrapper uses ordinary NT parameter mapping instead of Capicola's Alchemy-panel depth/routing pages.
Dedicated processing-control CV inputs are out of scope for version 1.
KeyframeRecorder RECORDING and PLAYBACK states are internal engine mechanisms, not an approved user-facing sampler transport.
Upstream diagnostic telemetry is not an audio-processing capability or first-release user feature.
The upstream engine setter is not exposed by Capicola's audited panel UI and its uncapped range is not part of the first-release surface.
